  • Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt.
  • Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer

CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern.

Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten.

Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll.

Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht.

Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn."

raw.title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) Gebäude-Energieberatung – Aufbau neuer Standort im Umland
raw.description:
Haben Sie schon länger über eine berufliche Veränderung nachgedacht? Möchten Sie ein Unternehmen als Geschäftsführer in unserem Franchise leiten und dabei eine Aufgabe übernehmen, die wirtschaftlich attraktiv ist und echten Sinn stiftet? Dann könnte diese Chance für Sie passen – insbesondere, wenn Sie aus einer dieser Regionen kommen:

  • Hannover
  • Hildesheim
  • Garbsen
  • Langenhagen
  • Laatzen

Gebäude-Energieberatung

Die Nachfrage nach Gebäude-Energieberatung steigt stark: Kunden wollen ihre Öl- und Gaskosten senken und Immobilien zukunftssicher sanieren. Gleichzeitig fehlen vielerorts Gebäude-Energieberater – das schafft hervorragende Chancen für Quereinsteiger.

Ideal für Quereinsteiger

Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung.

Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen

In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung.

ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint

Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke.

Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn

„Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen.

Aufgaben

Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen.

Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen.

Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben:

  • Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern
  • Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel
  • Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden
  • Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten
  • Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth
  • Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen
  • Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office

Qualifikation

Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen:

  • Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten.
  • Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen.
  • Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs.
  • Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern.
  • Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren.

Sie benötigen:

  • Technisches Verständnis
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen

Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater.

Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen.

Benefits

  • Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells
  • Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt.
  • Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer

CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern.

Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten.

Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll.

Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht.

Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn."

Du fühlst dich davon angesprochen und tickst ähnlich wie wir bei ENERDOMO – Das Original?

title: AI/ML Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Our agents are the product. Every case Valova codes runs through agentic systems that read clinical documentation, apply coding rules and justify every decision. How accurate, how fast and how efficient these systems are decides how much revenue hospitals recover and how much time coders get back. As AI/ML Engineer, you own the core of Valova : the agents that turn long, unstructured German clinical documentation into codes a hospital can bill and defend. You decide how we combine large and small models, how we measure quality and how new research makes it into production within weeks, not quarters . Your impact is directly measurable: in coding accuracy, in token costs per case and in hospitals that trust every decision because they can trace it. This is a hands-on engineering role building AI systems in production with real users. It’s not academic research, and it’s not prompt tinkering on the side of a product others build. How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on the agent pipeline, infrastructure and evaluation. With Malte and our product team, you translate what is technically possible into product decisions. Our doctors and coding experts are your sparring partners for clinical quality, and our forward deployed team brings back how the agents perform in real hospitals. Du berichtest direkt an Christian, unseren CTO, und arbeitest täglich mit unserem Engineering-Team an der Agenten-Pipeline, der Infrastruktur und der Evaluation. Mit Malte und unserem Produktteam übersetzt Du, was technisch möglich ist, in Produktentscheidungen. Unsere Ärzt:innen und Kodierexpert:innen sind Deine Sparringspartner für klinische Qualität, und unser Forward-Deployed-Team bringt zurück, wie die Agenten in echten Kliniken performen. What you will do Build state-of-the-art agents: You build high-performing agentic systems that define the state of the art in healthcare text processing, while staying efficient in token usage and leveraging small models wherever possible. Make every decision traceable: You ensure every decision and output of our agents is traced, and you monitor their performance in production. Measure what matters: You build the evaluation and benchmarking setup that tells us, on every change, whether our agents got better or worse. Bring research to production: You follow new AI/ML approaches, benchmark promising ideas and make sure the best results reach production within weeks. Shape the product: You use your AI/ML expertise to evaluate future projects and inform product decisions. What we are looking for: Production experience: At least two years building and shipping ML/AI systems in production. LLM and agent expertise: Strong experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks. Engineering depth: Strong proficiency in your primary programming language. Evaluation mindset: Experience with observability, evaluation and benchmarking of ML systems. Product mindset: You care about outcomes that lead to great user experiences and are passionate about using LLMs in real-world scenarios rather than academic research. Nice to have: Experience in healthcare, regulated environments or with sensitive data. Languages: You speak fluent English. German is a big plus, since the clinical documents our agents process are in German. Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin. Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you! What you get Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system. Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined. Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals. Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%. Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare. One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner. Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with. What success looks like After 3 months, you know our agent pipeline inside out, every agent decision is traced, and you have shipped your first improvement to production. After 6 months, our evaluation and benchmarking setup runs on every change, and you have measurably improved coding quality or reduced token costs per case. After 12 months, at least one new approach from research is running in production, and parts of our pipeline run on smaller models without losing quality. Throughout, our AI-related product decisions are grounded in your benchmarks, and the team turns to you when a new model or method comes out. How it works Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps: Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into the ML/AI systems you’ve built and how you evaluated them in production. raw.title: AI/ML Engineer (f/m/d)
raw.description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients.

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs, while most German hospitals already operate at a loss.

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash. Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital, until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe.

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin. Join us!

Why this role matters

Our agents are the product. Every case Valova codes runs through agentic systems that read clinical documentation, apply coding rules and justify every decision. How accurate, how fast and how efficient these systems are decides how much revenue hospitals recover and how much time coders get back. As AI/ML Engineer, you own the core of Valova: the agents that turn long, unstructured German clinical documentation into codes a hospital can bill and defend. You decide how we combine large and small models, how we measure quality and how new research makes it into production within weeks, not quarters.

Your impact is directly measurable: in coding accuracy, in token costs per case and in hospitals that trust every decision because they can trace it.

This is a hands-on engineering role building AI systems in production with real users. It’s not academic research, and it’s not prompt tinkering on the side of a product others build.

How the role sits in the team

You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on the agent pipeline, infrastructure and evaluation. With Malte and our product team, you translate what is technically possible into product decisions. Our doctors and coding experts are your sparring partners for clinical quality, and our forward deployed team brings back how the agents perform in real hospitals.

Du berichtest direkt an Christian, unseren CTO, und arbeitest täglich mit unserem Engineering-Team an der Agenten-Pipeline, der Infrastruktur und der Evaluation. Mit Malte und unserem Produktteam übersetzt Du, was technisch möglich ist, in Produktentscheidungen. Unsere Ärzt:innen und Kodierexpert:innen sind Deine Sparringspartner für klinische Qualität, und unser Forward-Deployed-Team bringt zurück, wie die Agenten in echten Kliniken performen.

What you will do

  • Build state-of-the-art agents: You build high-performing agentic systems that define the state of the art in healthcare text processing, while staying efficient in token usage and leveraging small models wherever possible.

  • Make every decision traceable: You ensure every decision and output of our agents is traced, and you monitor their performance in production.

  • Measure what matters: You build the evaluation and benchmarking setup that tells us, on every change, whether our agents got better or worse.

  • Bring research to production: You follow new AI/ML approaches, benchmark promising ideas and make sure the best results reach production within weeks.

  • Shape the product: You use your AI/ML expertise to evaluate future projects and inform product decisions.

What we are looking for:

  • Production experience: At least two years building and shipping ML/AI systems in production.

  • LLM and agent expertise: Strong experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks.

  • Engineering depth: Strong proficiency in your primary programming language.

  • Evaluation mindset: Experience with observability, evaluation and benchmarking of ML systems.

  • Product mindset: You care about outcomes that lead to great user experiences and are passionate about using LLMs in real-world scenarios rather than academic research.

  • Nice to have: Experience in healthcare, regulated environments or with sensitive data.

  • Languages: You speak fluent English. German is a big plus, since the clinical documents our agents process are in German.

  • Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin.

Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

What you get

  • Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system.

  • Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined.

  • Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals.

  • Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%.

  • Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare.

  • One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner.

  • Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with.

What success looks like

  • After 3 months, you know our agent pipeline inside out, every agent decision is traced, and you have shipped your first improvement to production.

  • After 6 months, our evaluation and benchmarking setup runs on every change, and you have measurably improved coding quality or reduced token costs per case.

  • After 12 months, at least one new approach from research is running in production, and parts of our pipeline run on smaller models without losing quality.

  • Throughout, our AI-related product decisions are grounded in your benchmarks, and the team turns to you when a new model or method comes out.

How it works

Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps:

  1. Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions.

  2. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into the ML/AI systems you’ve built and how you evaluated them in production.

  5. Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day.

title: Sales & Client Engagement Director (EMEA + DACH)
description: <h2>About us</h2> <p><a href="https://constructorlabs.org/">Constructor Labs</a> is the research arm of Constructor Knowledge, based at Campus Ring 1 in Bremen, Germany. Our work is organized around three units: Knowledge Labs, Cyber Labs and Science Labs. We apply computing, software and robotics research to make scientists, teachers and students more effective, working with institutional partners that include CERN, NUS, Carnegie Mellon and Fraunhofer.</p> <p>Our <a href="https://constructorlabs.org/solutions/edtech/">EdTech practice</a> produces research that runs in production. AI-supported remote proctoring is in use at the Irish Aviation Authority, Princess Nourah University and Saudi Electronic University, and our course delivery platform is used by CERN, EPFL, MariaDB and Acronis. For industry clients, we build tailored BSc, MSc and PhD pipelines, L&amp;D operating models, AI upskilling programmes and customer training systems.</p> <p><strong>Constructor Labs Solutions (CLS)</strong> is our client-facing systems integrator for the education and research sector, launching in September 2026. It brings audit and consultancy, content, platform, talent and R&amp;D services together under a single contract, an offer few providers make to education buyers today. Delivery is orchestrated across several Constructor organizations: CUB, Nexford, Nexademy, EBAC, Constructor Labs and Constructor Tech. Our aim is to become the go-to systems integrator for education in EMEA by 2029.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>You will open EMEA markets for Constructor Labs Solutions as a quota-carrying individual contributor. The role rests on an established network among universities, online education providers, EdTech vendors and corporate L&amp;D and research buyers, and on your ability to convert that network into signed engagements.</p> <p>You will work with the marketing and delivery teams to build pipeline, establish the CLS brand and develop a case-study library. Supporting you are a credible research institution, named production references, an existing Constructor and Constructor Tech client base, and delivery capability across five service lines that can be combined into a single proposal.</p> <p>The sales motion is consultative. Engagements typically open with a low-risk paid diagnostic (Technology Landscape Assessment, Curriculum Gap Analysis or Learning Strategy Advisory), which you then convert into a multi-line implementation or managed-service mandate. Initial engagements start at around €150–250K in lifetime value and grow from there. Sales cycles in public higher education run six to twelve months, so you will manage a long-cycle institutional funnel alongside faster corporate L&amp;D deals.</p> <h2>Reporting and scope</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director of Sales &amp; Marketing, Constructor Labs Solutions (shared with the Constructor Labs GM during Phase 1).</li> <li><strong>Level:</strong> Director, individual contributor. You will join an established sales team.</li> <li><strong>Territory:</strong> EMEA, with initial focus on DACH (Germany, Austria, Switzerland) and the UK and Ireland. Named accounts agreed quarterly.</li> <li><strong>Segments:</strong> traditional and online universities, EdTech providers and platform vendors, corporate L&amp;D and corporate academies, research-intensive organizations, and publicly funded research programmes.</li> <li><strong>Portfolio:</strong> all five CLS service lines, namely Audit &amp; Consultancy, Content, Platform, Talent and R&amp;D Services.</li> </ul> <p>Day-to-day, you will work with the Audit &amp; Consultancy Practice Head on scoping, with Nexademy on content propositions, with Constructor Tech on platform architecture, and with the Labs' principal investigators, who join client conversations to provide subject-matter credibility. Knowing which expert belongs in which conversation is central to the role.</p> <h2>What you will do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Pipeline generation.</strong> Around 70% of your time is spent on outbound activity: your own network, conference presence, sector associations, procurement frameworks and targeted account campaigns, supported by marketing.</li> <li><strong>Reference accounts.</strong> Sign the first reference clients in EMEA and develop each one into a published case study, an active sponsor and a source of introductions.</li> <li><strong>Discovery and scoping.</strong> Map the client's learning or research operating model and quantify the problem in their own measures: cost per course, time to accreditation, completion rates, time-to-hire, research throughput. Shape a diagnostic that leads to a defined follow-on engagement.</li> <li><strong>Conversion to implementation.</strong> Own the transition from paid diagnostic to multi-line mandate, with a target of converting half of all audit engagements.</li> <li><strong>Proposals and bids.</strong> Assemble proposals across the five service lines with the practice heads, price them against the finance model and qualify them against margin floors. Lead RFP and framework responses, including public-sector tenders in Germany and the UK.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder coverage.</strong> Engage rectors, deans, CIOs, heads of digital learning, procurement, works councils, CLOs, HR directors and research directors. Maintain at least three engaged contacts on every opportunity above €200K.</li> <li><strong>Partner channel.</strong> Recruit and manage regional partners, resellers, agencies and academic networks that extend reach beyond your direct coverage.</li> <li><strong>Quota and forecasting.</strong> You carry an annual new-business quota, with quarterly KPIs covering pipeline coverage, audit conversion, average engagement value and blended margin. Maintain weekly pipeline hygiene in the CRM, submit a forecast you can defend, and flag slippage as soon as you see it.</li> <li><strong>Market feedback.</strong> Report what EMEA buyers procure and what they decline, and how our pricing compares with Instructure, D2L, Cornerstone and the generalist integrators, so that the service catalogue can be adjusted.</li> <li><strong>External representation.</strong> Speak at sector events and contribute to thought leadership alongside our principal investigators, building recognition for CLS among education buyers in your region.</li> </ul> <h2>Targets and KPIs</h2> <p>The role carries a quota set on net-new signed bookings (total contract value) in your territory, with a six-month ramp and a quarterly review:</p> <ul> <li>Net-new signed bookings (TCV)</li> <li>Reference clients signed</li> <li>Average engagement value</li> <li>Audit-to-implementation conversion</li> <li>Blended gross margin on signed work</li> <li>New qualified opportunities created</li> <li>Forecast accuracy</li> </ul> <h2>What you bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Network in the sector.</strong> Eight or more years selling into education, research or corporate learning in EMEA, preferably DACH and/or the UK, with decision-maker relationships you can open within the first 90 days. You should be prepared to discuss your top 15 target accounts and the route into each.</li> <li><strong>A closing record in complex services.</strong> Consistent achievement against a quota of €1M or more in professional services, consulting, systems integration or enterprise EdTech, covering six-figure deals, multi-stakeholder buying groups and six- to twelve-month cycles.</li> <li><strong>Consultative selling.</strong> Experience selling scoped engagements whose deliverables were defined jointly with the client, and fluency in a recognized methodology such as MEDDIC, Challenger or Command of the Message.</li> <li><strong>Domain credibility.</strong> The ability to hold a substantive conversation with a pro-vice-chancellor about digitalization, a CLO about competency frameworks or a research director about co-funded projects, together with a working understanding of how universities and research organizations buy: budget cycles, committee approval, procurement frameworks and public tender rules.</li> <li><strong>Comfort in an early-stage unit.</strong> Experience building a territory or a new offering from a standing start, and the ability to sell a service catalogue that is still being completed.</li> <li><strong>Languages.</strong> Business-fluent <strong>German</strong> and <strong>English</strong>. Both are required, since public education buyers in DACH contract in German.</li> <li><strong>Commercial discipline.</strong> Rigorous CRM and forecasting practice, and a readiness to qualify out early rather than carry unlikely deals.</li> <li><strong>Professional integrity.</strong> You will represent a research institution to universities and public bodies, so commitments made during the sales process must be ones delivery can meet.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience selling into publicly funded research programmes, or EU and national grant-co-funded projects (Horizon Europe, Innovate UK, BMBF).</li> <li>Working knowledge of the LMS/SIS landscape and its incumbents — Instructure, D2L, Cornerstone, Moodle, SAP SuccessFactors.</li> <li>Experience with UK public procurement frameworks (Crown Commercial Service, JISC) or German public tendering (VgV, e-Vergabe).</li> <li>Background in the education practice of a systems integrator, Big Four firm or consultancy.</li> <li>Prior success selling talent, recruitment or academic content services.</li> <li>French, Italian or Dutch as a third language.</li> <li>An existing speaking profile in the education or L&amp;D community.</li> </ul> <h2>Location and travel</h2> <p>Candidates must be based in Europe and hold an existing, unrestricted right to work in their country of residence. <strong>Relocation is not offered for this position:</strong> the network the role depends on should already be in the market.</p> <p>Preferred bases are Germany, Switzerland, Bulgaria or the UK. The role is remote or hybrid, with regular time in Bremen and at the London commercial hub. Expect travel of up to 40% within EMEA for client meetings, tenders and sector events, plus occasional travel to other Constructor locations.</p> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Base salary and commission</strong>, weighted approximately 60/40 at on-target earnings, with accelerators above 100% of quota. The band is competitive for a Director-level individual contributor in DACH or the UK and depends on location and experience.</li> <li><strong>A guaranteed ramp</strong> across the first two quarters while the pipeline is built.</li> <li><strong>Commission on margin as well as revenue</strong>, so that well-scoped work is rewarded ahead of discounted work.</li> <li><strong>Access to our researchers</strong>, including principal investigators, CERN-level data scientists, and education methodologists who will join your client meetings.</li> <li><strong>An existing reference base</strong>, including named proctoring and platform deployments.</li> <li><strong>Influence over the offering.</strong> As the key commercial voice in these markets, you will shape a service catalogue that is not yet fixed.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Analyst (12-month contract)
description: <p>Hi! We’re hipages, an ASX-listed tech company and Australia’s #1 digital platform connecting households with trusted home improvement businesses. We're on a mission to transform the home improvement industry to build better lives for everyone.</p> <p>With teams across Australia, New Zealand, the Philippines and Vietnam, we work as one team with a shared purpose. We’re proud to be a certified <strong>Great Place to Work</strong> and <strong>WORK180’s #1 Employer for Women</strong>. At hipages, you’ll find real impact, career growth and a workplace where everyone belongs.</p> <div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>This is a 12-month parental leave contract. As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll help the organisation make better decisions with data. You’ll work closely with the data team and your insights will feed directly into hipages’ commercial strategy.</p> <p>You’ll help shape the hipages marketplace as it evolves, using your experience to improve things for our customers. You’ll also join a supportive, highly skilled data team whose skills cover everything from engineering to machine learning, where people share what they know and celebrate each other’s wins.</p> <p>You’ll work with colleagues across the business on reporting, insights and analytics for a range of projects, from channel performance to segmentation.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Why join our Data team?</strong></p> <ul> <li>💻 Hybrid working with 2 days WFH, so you can fit work around the rest of your life</li> <li>🪴 An in-house Talent Development team focused on your personal and career growth</li> <li>💰 Competitive salary, benefits and perks</li> <li>🤝 A collaborative culture working with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Commercial teams</li> <li>🧑‍🏫 Hands-on learning, workshops and mentoring to keep growing your skills</li> <li>♀️ Women make up 50% of our Data team, so you’ll be joining a balanced team where your voice is heard</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How you’ll add value:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a framework for sharing insights with the business and recommending product improvements</li> <li>Analyse data, trends and results, and explain their business impact to stakeholders</li> <li>Explore the acquisition funnel to find insights and opportunities that grow jobs and tradie numbers</li> <li>Give teams the data they need to shape use cases and requirements</li> <li>Help grow our user base by supporting segmentation strategies for a more personalised customer experience</li> <li>Design, run and measure feature experiments</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Data analytics experience in an e-commerce or technology company</li> <li>Experience working with enterprise data warehouses</li> <li>A love of data, and the ability to make sense of complex information and tell a clear story with it</li> <li>You can turn findings into business recommendations that people act on</li> <li>Strong communication skills, and you build trusted relationships with stakeholders</li> <li>Advanced SQL (or equivalent)</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a marketplace or digital-native organisation</li> <li>Google Analytics and A/B testing for SaaS products</li> <li>Forecasting and statistical modelling</li> <li>Understanding of ETL frameworks and tools</li> <li>dbt or data modelling experience</li> <li>Intermediate Python</li> <li>Databricks or Snowflake</li> <li>Salesforce</li> <li>A tertiary degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Actuarial Studies or a related field</li> </ul> <p><strong>Don’t tick every box?</strong> Research shows women often hold back from applying unless they meet every requirement. If this role excites you and you meet most of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you. We’re happy to talk about flexible arrangements and any adjustments you need during the recruitment process.</p> <p></p> <p></p> </div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Life at hipages:</strong></p> <p>We’re more than just a workplace. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

Dust is seeking a UK Partnerships Manager to grow our partner ecosystem in the UK. This is a business development role at its core: your job is to identify, engage, and activate the partners who will become a meaningful source of pipeline and revenue for Dust in the UK market.

This is a 0-to-1 role. There is no existing UK partner program, no playbook, no team. You'll be the first person on the ground, responsible for building relationships, closing early partnership agreements, and proving that partners can generate real pipeline for Dust. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Field Marketing, Growth, Community, the France Partnerships team, and the Executive Team to make this happen.

All types of partnerships are in scope: resellers, system integrators, consultancies, agencies, tech alliances, affiliates, community partners, and anything else that drives results. We care about what works, not what fits a predefined category.

The Solution Partner Ecosystem is the second biggest growth lever at Dust, yet UK's agency and professional services market is still almost entirely untapped.

As Partner Manager UK at Dust, you will build partnerships with leading agencies to boost partner-led revenue. Your job is to find the right partners in the UK, recruit them, and get them to their first win fast, and then transform into a repeatable motion. Working directly with our global partnerships team, you'll own the outreach motion, the onboarding, and the early relationship with every new partner you bring in, primarily AI transformation agencies and consultants.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build a relationship quickly, has entrepreneurial, and can craft joint solutions that makes partners want to invest in Dust. You will be part of a growing global partnerships team of 6 people, with dedicated support from partner operations, solutions engineer and partner marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Ecosystem Development

  • Build Dust's UK partner ecosystem. Identify, qualify, and recruit the partners best positioned to Dust’s ICP buyers in the UK,

  • Drive partners to pipeline. This isn't about signing partner logos. Your success is measured by partners generating qualified opportunities, co-selling with Dust AEs, and closing deals. Own the full journey from first conversation to first partner-sourced deal

  • Create activation playbooks that take partners from signed agreement to actively selling. Build the training, enablement, and co-selling infrastructure needed to make partners effective

  • Own UK partnership pipeline and revenue targets, with latitude to experiment with creative deal structures, incentive models, and go-to-market approaches

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work hand-in-hand with UK Sales (AEs and BDRs) to ensure partners are pipeline accelerators. Build deal routing, co-selling motions, and account mapping that the sales team actually uses

  • Collaborate with Field Marketing (Events, Content, Community) to build joint events, co-branded content, and community activations that serve both partner development and demand generation

  • Stay tightly connected with the Global Partnerships team to share learnings, adapt proven playbooks, and maintain consistency where it matters

  • Partner with Growth Marketing to turn partner activity into scalable demand: co-hosted webinars, joint case studies, partner-led content, and event-driven pipeline

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on integration priorities, partner feedback, and joint solution development where relevant

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • High AI literacy, you're already using AI daily in your work and can articulate how you'd apply it to partnerships at Dust

  • Proven go-to-market strategy experience: customer-obsessed, first-principles thinking, not just copy-pasting past playbooks

  • Experience building partnerships at a startup or scale-up (not large enterprise reseller models)

  • Specific experience with agency partners, system integrators, or similar zero-to-one motions

  • Grit and sales acumen, you can convince partners, hold them accountable, and go through windows when doors are closed

Attitude

  • Team player who solves for Dust and its customers, not just partnerships metrics

  • Low ego, high impact, you leverage others' work and make the broader team better

  • Decisive — you make tough calls on prioritisation and aren't afraid to cut partnerships that aren't working

  • Direct and transparent, you surface problems early and give honest feedback

  • User-first orientation, you frame decisions around customer outcomes without being prompted

Agency

  • You unblock yourself with AI and people, scaling your impact through tools and cross-functional leverage

  • You own outcomes end-to-end, identifying gaps, building solutions, and driving to resolution without being told

  • You challenge the goal when it's wrong, high agency in execution AND thinking

  • You've expanded your scope by solving problems no one assigned you

  • You launch things without waiting for permission and find ways to deliver with limited resources

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

raw.title: Account Executive (Mid-Market)
raw.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

We're expanding into the UK and Ireland, and this is the role that makes it real. As an early Account Executive in the region, you'll own the full sales cycle across fintech, financial services, and B2B SaaS — landing net-new logos and building the GTM motion from the ground up. You'll work alongside a dedicated Solutions Engineer and BDR, but this is a builder role: you'll shape how Dust sells in this market, not inherit a finished playbook. If you want a career-defining opportunity to open a market for a product you believe in, this is it.

What you'll do

Own UK & Ireland revenue

  • Drive net-new logo acquisition across fintech, financial services, and B2B SaaS — hitting $250K/quarter ramping to full quota by Q3

  • Self-generate pipeline when BDR-sourced pipe is thin; attend events and customer workshops to build presence and create opportunities

  • Convert pilots to closed contracts at a ~65% rate, managing deal cycles end-to-end without heavy support infrastructure

Run a consultative, insight-led sales motion

  • Lead discovery calls that surface genuine workflow pain and connect it credibly to Dust's platform capabilities

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes — including technical buyers (VP Eng, CTO, Head of Data) and business stakeholders across CS, RevOps, and Finance

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to deliver compelling, tailored demos that turn sceptics into believers

Build the UK playbook

  • Work with management to shape the regional GTM motion — what ICPs convert, what messaging lands, what the buying journey looks like in the UK market

  • Collaborate closely with the GTM team to refine outbound targeting and sequencing based on what you're seeing in the field

  • Feed market intelligence back to the broader sales and product teams to inform how Dust evolves

Sell credibly into AI-forward buyers

  • Position Dust's platform with conviction to technical and business decision-makers who are actively building AI strategies

  • Engage meaningfully on how AI is reshaping how companies operate — not just as a vendor, but as a practitioner who uses Dust yourself

  • Help prospects understand the difference between Dust and point solutions or build-your-own approaches

Show up as a multiplier

  • Work closely with the broader sales, marketing and product teams by sharing context, feedback, and what you're learning from the market

  • Contribute to a nascent UK team culture — the way you operate will shape what the regional team looks like as it grows

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Track record of closing mid-market deals across multi-stakeholder buying committees in B2B SaaS or technical software — you can articulate exactly how you won, not just that you did

  • Proven ability to sell to technical buyers and translate complex product capability into clear business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders

  • Strong outbound instincts — you can identify the right accounts, build compelling and personalised messaging, and open doors without heavy SDR coverage

  • History of consistent quota attainment in lean, low-infrastructure environments where you built the motion rather than executed against a mature playbook

  • Genuine AI fluency — you actively use AI tools in your own workflow and can speak credibly to how AI is reshaping operations across the verticals you'll be selling into

Attitude

  • Energised by ambiguity — building a new market from scratch excites you more than executing against a finished playbook

  • Makes the people around them better — you collaborate generously with SE and BDR, share what you learn, and create lift for the team without ego

  • Gives and receives direct feedback; surfaces problems early rather than letting them compound quietly

  • Goes deep on customers, their industries, and their specific pain — curiosity is your competitive advantage

  • Believes in the mission and it shows — you sell with conviction because you use Dust and understand what it does

Agency

  • Defines your role in outcomes, not tasks — you own UK revenue growth, not a list of responsibilities

  • Self-generates pipeline and invents new approaches when existing channels are insufficient, without waiting to be told

  • Drives deals end-to-end without escalation or hand-holding — from first touch to closed contract, you own the path

  • Spots gaps in the UK GTM motion and proposes solutions proactively rather than flagging problems upward

  • Shows up to this process with initiative — you've researched Dust, used the product, and come with ideas, not just questions

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description: Hi 👋 I’m Nitesh, Engineering Manager at hyperexponential. I'm one for the career mentors in the Product Foundations stream. We tackle the fundamental problems every product team at hx runs into, so the vertical streams can focus on building features for customers. Right now that means deployments, observability, security, AI observability tooling and a permission service that other value streams will build on. I’m hiring a Senior Security Engineer to join us as our second security hire. The foundations are already in place. We’ve chosen and implemented our tooling, and our repositories and cloud environments are onboarded. The next step is shaping how security actually works here. This won’t be a traditional, hierarchical security function. Our engineers go straight to the person who owns an issue and ask them to fix it, and you’ll help define what security looks like in that model. There’s no established playbook for this yet, which is what makes it exciting. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, I’d love to hear from you. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. title: Solutions Architect - Search Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role</strong></h3> <p>At Elastic, we're revolutionizing the search and data analytics space. We're pioneers in the integration of Gen AI, powerful retrieval models like ELSER, and cutting-edge semantic search technologies like vector search, empowering businesses to unlock unprecedented insights and experiences.</p> <p>As a Search Solutions Architect, you'll be at the forefront of this transformative journey. You'll play a pivotal role in designing and deploying innovative solutions that leverage the combined power of these technologies, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your work will directly influence the success of organizations worldwide, helping them unlock new opportunities and make insightful decisions.&nbsp;</p> <p>Are you ready to join the Elastic Revolution and be a pioneer in the next generation of Search powered AI?&nbsp;Apply now and embark on this exciting journey with us!&nbsp;We're eager to welcome you to a team that's shaping the future and helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect next-generation search solutions: Design and implement cutting-edge solutions utilizing Elastic's latest advancements in AI, semantic search, and vector search, including RAG, vector databases, and other emerging technologies.</li> <li>Harness the power of ELSER: Enable organizations to achieve unparalleled accuracy and efficiency in their search queries and data retrieval processes, leveraging the capabilities of the Elastic Learned Sparse Encoder.</li> <li>Unlock the potential of vector search: Implement powerful vector search algorithms and create high-dimensional vector representations of data, allowing users to find the information they need even with imprecise queries.</li> <li>Deliver compelling proof-of-concept (POC) projects: Showcase the combined value of AI, semantic search, vector search, and ELSER through successful POCs, demonstrating the potential for improved search relevance, user experience, and decision-making.</li> <li>Become a thought leader and evangelize our vision: Share your expertise through presentations, blog posts, and other channels, positioning Elastic as the leader in AI-powered search and semantic data exploration.</li> <li>Cultivate a collaborative environment within the Solutions Architecture team and across departments, promoting knowledge sharing and driving continuous improvement.</li> <li>Collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, data scientists, and industry experts who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of search and AI-powered solutions.</li> <li>Continuously learn and explore the ever-evolving landscapes of AI, semantic search, vector search, and related technologies, ensuring your solutions are always at the forefront of innovation. We&nbsp;provide access to world-class training programs and cutting-edge technology.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in designing and architecting enterprise-level search solutions.</li> <li>Deep understanding of AI and semantic search technologies, with a focus on RAG, vector search, and NLP.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging ecosystem technologies and how they interoperate like Hugging Face, Langchain, etc.</li> <li>Solid knowledge of ELSER's architecture and other models within the Hugging Face ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience with vector databases and other emerging data storage solutions.</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. We think of it like this, “ You may be speaking to a developer in the morning, an architect in the afternoon and an executive buyer in the evening.”</li> <li>Collaborative spirit and a passion for sharing knowledge and expertise.</li> <li>Unwavering commitment to continuous learning and staying ahead of the curve in technology and emerging trends.</li> <li>Fluency in Spanish would be an advantage.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-PF1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email </span><span style="font-weight: ----- style="font-weight: 400;"> We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below:</span> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf" target="_blank">Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster;</span><span style="color: #000000;">&nbsp;<a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_%20English_formattedESQA508c.pdf" target="_blank">Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision</a> Poster; </span><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppabw.pdf" target="_blank">Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster and <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights.pdf" target="_blank">Know Your Rights</a> (Poster)</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Elasticsearch develops and distributes encryption software and technology that is subject to U.S. export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, the Crimea Region of Ukraine, the Donetsk People’s Republic (“DNR”), and the Luhansk People’s Republic (“LNR”). But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.</p> <p>When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.</p> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Field CTO – EMEA</strong></p> <p><strong>Why We Have This Role</strong></p> <p>The EMEA Field CTO organization serves as the primary bridge between Qualtrics' product vision, customer strategy, field execution, and market innovation. In this role, your mandate is to Innovate, Prove, and Scale: you will partner with C-suite executives at strategic enterprise customers to shape their Experience Management (XM), AI, and enterprise technology transformation strategies. You won't just support deals—you'll generate new intellectual property, enterprise architectures, and sales motions that elevate how our entire field sales engineering team engages the market. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, you will establish Qualtrics as an indispensable platform within complex enterprise ecosystems.</p> <p><strong>How You’ll Find Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strategic Innovation: A passion for developing differentiated platform positioning, strategic sales motions, and novel solution architectures that extend beyond single deal cycles.</li> <li>Executive Presence: Excitement around partnering with Fortune 500 C-suite leaders to deliver visionary keynotes, executive workshops, and high-impact advisory sessions.</li> <li>Systems &amp; Ecosystem Thinking: A knack for connecting Qualtrics to broader enterprise technology stacks, including AI, data platforms, cloud, CRM, and ERP systems.</li> <li>Product-Field Translation: Enthusiasm for translating real-world market shifts, customer needs, and emerging technologies into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering teams.</li> <li>Scalable Mentorship: Joy in coaching, enabling, and scaling proven approaches to the broader field engineering organization to lift collective capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How You’ll Grow</strong></p> <ul> <li>Executive &amp; Advisory Standing: Expand your profile as an industry thought leader through speaking engagements, publications, analyst meetings, and executive briefings.</li> <li>Frontier Technology Mastery: Deepen your technical edge at the intersection of Enterprise Experience Management, Generative/Agentic AI, and enterprise data architecture.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Influence: Build top-tier strategic leadership experience by directly shaping Product roadmaps and field-wide go-to-market strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Things You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Innovate Platform Positioning: Create and deploy new enterprise solution architectures, AI use cases, and strategic sales campaigns to position Qualtrics as a core platform in evolving market shifts.</li> <li>Prove Impact on Strategic Deals: Partner with Sales Engineering and AEs on our largest enterprise opportunities to validate innovative positioning and drive measurable business outcomes through executive workshops.</li> <li>Scale Capability to the Field: Package successful customer engagements into repeatable solution architectures, strategic sales plays, and enablement assets adopted by the broader sales engineering org.</li> <li>Influence Product Strategy: Establish a continuous feedback loop between Fortune 500 customers and internal Product &amp; Engineering teams to prioritize key roadmap investments.</li> <li>Represent Qualtrics Globally: Drive market leadership by presenting at industry conferences, customer events, analyst briefings, and executive advisory sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For On Your CV</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record in enterprise solution architecture, strategic presales, or Field CTO roles within enterprise software.</li> <li>Demonstrated capability in architecting and positioning complex platforms alongside enterprise AI, data strategy, cloud, CRM, or CDP environments.</li> <li>Hands-on experience engaging and advising C-level executives at Fortune 500 organizations on digital transformation and business value.</li> <li>Track record of building repeatable intellectual property, technical positioning frameworks, or field enablement programs that scale across an organization.</li> <li>Cross-functional execution experience aligning Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Should Know About This Team</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>High-Impact Innovation Hub:</strong> We are not just deal support—we act as an internal incubator for new ideas, generating intellectual property, enterprise architectures, and sales plays that elevate the entire company's go-to-market strategy.</li> <li><strong>Direct Influence on Product &amp; Strategy:</strong> We sit at the exact intersection of field execution and product vision, giving us a direct voice to shape Qualtrics' platform strategy and influence product roadmaps based on real-world Fortune 500 interactions.</li> <li><strong>Peer Community of Technical Experts:</strong> You’ll work alongside seasoned enterprise architects and industry thought leaders who value collaboration, high-velocity problem solving, and sharing technical innovation across the group.</li> <li><strong>C-Suite Access &amp; Executive Visibility:</strong> Our team leads the highest-stakes executive engagements, board-level vision sessions, and customer workshops across EMEA, giving you unmatched visibility inside and outside the company.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Scaled Mentorship:</strong> We believe a win for one is a win for all; we actively invest time in translating individual successes into enablement programs that lift the capabilities of the broader field sales engineering org.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits</strong></p> <p><strong>Global Perks &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Comprehensive Healthcare &amp; Mental Health:</strong> Fully funded Bupa private medical and dental insurance for you and your dependents, alongside 24/7 confidential mental health support, coaching, and care resources.</li> <li><strong>Paid Leave:</strong> 25 days annual leave per year, plus 1 additional day per year of service (up to 5 additional days), alongside additional family support leave programs.</li> <li><strong>Financial Protection &amp; Equity:</strong> Income protection (66% of salary after 13 weeks of illness), death in service benefit (up to 4x salary), business travel accident coverage, and an Employee Equity Purchase Plan.</li> <li><strong>Professional Growth &amp; Career Support:</strong> Career Action Plans, mentorship programs, and resources covering interpersonal skills, time management, and work-life balance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Regional &amp; Team Perks (UK)</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Quarterly Wellness Allowance:</strong> Wellness reimbursement of up to £300 gross per quarter to support activities for you and your family.</li> <li><strong>Company Pension Plan:</strong> 9% employer contribution with a 5% employee salary sacrifice contribution.</li> <li><strong>Commuter Assistance:</strong> Up to £5,000 gross per year paid monthly via payroll toward commuting costs.</li> <li><strong>Family Support &amp; Experience Bonus:</strong> Annual Experience Bonus of £1,450 after one year of employment, plus adoption and surrogacy reimbursement up to £8,200.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model</strong>: <em>Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid</em></p> <p><em>Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.</em></p> <p><em>​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:<a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/fmla">Family &amp; Medical Leave Act</a>,<a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/poster"> Equal Opportunity Employment</a>,<a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/employee-polygraph-protection-act"> Employee Polygraph Protection Act</a></em></p> <p><em>Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.</em></p> <p><em>Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
