title: Principal Product Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members across UK and India</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE TEAM:&nbsp;</h3> <p>The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Threat Detection &amp; Response, and Identity.</p> <p><strong>Product Security</strong> (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.</p> <p><strong>Threat Detection &amp; Response</strong> focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.</p> <p><strong>Identity</strong> is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.</p> <p>While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.</p> <h3><br>ABOUT THE ROLE:&nbsp;</h3> <p><strong>As a Senior Product Security Engineer you’ll:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Regularly dive deep into mobile, web app technologies in order to understand feature development and proactively hunt for vulnerabilities</li> <li>Be proficient in securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that security best practices are applied consistently across our cloud environment</li> <li>Be proficient in threat modelling and guide developers in secure design principles to prevent vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place</li> <li>Help remediate vulnerabilities through strategic initiatives, writing patches, or creating understandable and actionable vulnerability tickets.</li> <li>Be the subject matter expert across a wide range of security areas, particularly in Application Security.</li> <li>Make security invisible when possible, believing that gatekeeping and blocking product teams should be avoided in favour of enabling secure development.</li> <li>Mentor and coach junior engineers, sharing your knowledge to help raise the security bar across the organisation</li> <li>Leverage automation and security tools to seamlessly integrate security into our CI/CD pipelines, ensuring vulnerabilities are caught early without disrupting development.</li> </ul> <h3><br>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:&nbsp;</h3> <p>First and foremost you will be passionate about security and resilient software development processes. You will enjoy hunting for vulnerabilities in our web and mobile applications and working with our engineering teams to remediate them strategically. You will be comfortable explaining security issues and concerns to product owners, engineers, VPs and executives and love the feeling you get when this results in them releasing a more resilient product. You will be a keen follower of all things Infosec and constantly be on the lookout for ways to apply new industry trends, tools and automations to your day-to-day role.</p> <p><strong>What makes you a great fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a breadth and depth of knowledge across AppSec; you’re expected to understand topics like why private keys should be stored in the Secure Enclave, the differences between URL Schemes and Universal Links, what presigned URLs are in the context of S3 and the safest storage mechanisms for modern browsers.</li> <li>You know Burp Suite (or your favourite attack proxy) inside and out; bonus points if you’ve written or contributed to an extension that enhances its functionality.</li> <li>You have excellent spoken and written communication skills to articulate vulnerabilities clearly and persuasively, advocating for their remediation even when faced with competing production pressures.</li> <li>As a passionate senior security engineer, you have a blog, public speaking engagements, bug bounty profile, or a Git repository showcasing your work.</li> <li>You’re comfortable writing proof-of-concept (POC) scripts to demonstrate your findings and their potential impact, as needed.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience with securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that best practices are consistently applied</li> </ul> <h3><br>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Group Life Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>We invest in your development with a £1,000 professional L&amp;D budget per year</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand-new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>3 days for L&amp;D or volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible working options</li> <li>Sabbatical leave&nbsp;</li> <li>Share options</li> </ul> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>#LI-MP1</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-Remote</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p><em>Engineering the future of customer support — at global scale</em> 🌍</p> <p>We believe exceptional customer service is more than just a feature, it’s a fundamental part of who we are. That’s why we’ve built our own internal support tooling from the ground up, tailored to help our customer, courier, and merchant support teams shine in every interaction.</p> <p>As we scale our operations from 30 to 60 countries, supporting millions of users and partners, our internal tools need to scale with us. About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)
description: Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées À propos de l'opportunité Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants. En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp. Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Ce que nous recherchons Indispensable Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer. Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Atouts Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp. Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème. Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans. Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois. Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales. Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer. Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Formation et accompagnement Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation. title: Senior Value Engineer - Supply Chain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p>The position of the&nbsp;<strong>Senior Value Engineer</strong>&nbsp;is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.</p> <p><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong><strong><br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Identify &amp; Frame Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases</li> <li>Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers&nbsp;</li> <li>Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive</li> </ul> <p><strong>Realize Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement</li> <li>Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives</li> <li>Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scale Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing</li> <li>Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion</li> <li>Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Live for Customer Value: </strong>Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Data, Analytics, Applications &amp; IT: </strong>Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),&nbsp; experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of <strong>Python</strong> and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.</p> <p><strong>Process Improvement &amp; Value Realization: </strong>Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,&nbsp; being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value</p> <p><strong>Project Management: </strong>Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.</p> <p><strong>Executive Stakeholder Management: </strong>Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.</p> <p><strong>Business Domain Expertise: </strong>Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)</p> <p><strong>Industry Expertise: </strong>Ideally expertise in Aviation/Logistics/Transportation and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities&nbsp; <strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Degree: </strong>In Technology &amp; Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1264">Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) indépendant
description: <h1>Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)&nbsp;</h1> <p>Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées</p> <h2>À propos de l’opportunité</h2> <p>Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.</p> <p>En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.</p> <p>Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</p> </li> <li> <p>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</p> </li> <li> <p>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.</p> </li> <li> <p>Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d’expérience et à persévérer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une bonne compréhension du statut d’indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Atouts</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Un réseau existant de chefs d’entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.</p> <h2>Rémunération</h2> <p>Il s’agit d’une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l’activité des commerçants apportés.</p> <p>Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :</p> <ul> <li> <p>Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.</p> </li> <li> <p>Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.</p> </li> <li> <p>Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d’activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s’appliquer.</p> <p>Les conditions d’éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s’entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.</p> <h2>Formation et accompagnement</h2> <p>Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l’accompagnement des clients.</p> <p>Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.</p> <p>Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d’analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d’organisation.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Growth - France (CDD)
description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France. We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market. This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time. This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth. You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. This role will own: Winning new business Go-to-market strategy and execution Client onboarding and implementation support Account management and expansion What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results for the French market (pipeline, revenue and partner success) Building and managing a strong pipeline of partners across key segments (OEMs, energy retailers, installers, platforms, etc.) Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing considerations, customer segmentation and launch strategies Managing post-implementation relationships with clients after go-live, driving continuous improvement and opportunity to deepen engagement or grow the account Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements Building and refine scalable sales and partner processes that support repeatable growth across different customer segments Tracking performance, pipeline, and outcomes, using data to prioritise effort and continuously improve commercial effectiveness Operating with low structure and high ownership: remove friction, avoid bureaucracy, move fast What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Drive Adoption &amp; Business Impact</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Work closely with end users</li> <li>Measure adoption and outcomes</li> <li>Accelerate AI transformation across your domain</li> </ul> <h4><strong>4. Grow AI Capability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders</li> <li>Share knowledge and reusable components</li> <li>Build AI expertise within your organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success Metrics</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Business impact delivered by AI initiatives</li> <li>Adoption within the domain</li> <li>Technical quality and reliability</li> <li>Team capability growth</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Our stack and tools</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Languages: </strong>Python and SQL</li> <li><strong>AI Stack:&nbsp;</strong>OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models</li> <li><strong>Agentic &amp; Retrieval: </strong>LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure: </strong>AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>You'll Love This Job If you have&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI</li> <li>Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems</li> <li>Ability to influence Product and Business decisions</li> <li>Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Want to join us? <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.</strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">&nbsp;</p> <p>Capco recherche des <strong>Product Managers</strong> pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.</p> <p>Au sein de notre capability <strong>Tech, Product &amp; Engineering</strong>, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.</p> <p>Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.</p> <p>Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.</li> <li>Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.</li> <li>Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs<strong> </strong>et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.</li> <li>Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.</li> <li>Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences et expériences désirées&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.</li> <li>Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.</li> <li>Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.</li> <li>Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.</li> <li>Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.</li> <li>Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?</strong></p> <p>Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.<br>Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris.&nbsp;</p> <p>Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.</p> <p><strong>Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.</strong></p> <p>Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Nos marqueurs distinctifs :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Une spécialisation sectorielle forte</strong><br>Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.</li> <li><strong>Une approche collaborative et sur mesure</strong><br>Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.</li> <li><strong>L’excellence comme exigence</strong><br>Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.</li> <li><strong>Un esprit “One Capco”</strong><br>Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive</strong><br>L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires</strong></p> <ol> <li>Stratégie &amp; Transformation</li> <li>Finance, Risque &amp; Conformité</li> <li>Product, Innovation &amp; Design</li> <li>Data &amp; Analytics</li> <li>Conseil Tech (Advisory)</li> <li>Engineering (Delivery)</li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Chez Capco, nous vous offrons&nbsp;:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels</li> <li>Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise</li> <li>Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)</li> <li>Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance</li> <li>Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an</li> <li>Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work</li> <li>Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain&nbsp;:</li> <ul> <li>#BeYourselfAtWork</li> <li>Woman@capco</li> <li>RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)</li> <li>Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles</li> </ul> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Chez Capco Paris, handicap visible ou invisible, parcours atypique ou classique, toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues et seront traitées avec équité.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Analyst, France & Netherlands (12 Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><em>Please note this is a hybrid position from our Paris office. Please submit your CV in English.</em></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></span></p> <p>The Global Markets Strategic Finance &amp; Analytics team provides budget oversight, reporting, strategic planning and analytical decision making support to the Global Markets team and in-region business teams across EMEA. In addition this team supports identifying and pursuing opportunities to drive growth and business impact for our international business.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>The Difference You Will Make</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>While your formal reporting structure is into the Director, Strategic Finance &amp; Analytics, EMEA, on a day-to-day basis you will work closely with the cross-functional team that is based in-region.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will directly support Country Managers (and their teams) based around EMEA to drive clear reporting, produce actionable insight, track core KPIs, evaluate investment decisions and work cross-functionally to develop strategies to solve problems.</li> <li>The individual is expected to be a strong cross-functional business partner who has a combination of hands-on analytical skills, financial modelling expertise, commercial acumen, and the ability to package their insights into strong narratives appropriate for senior executive consumption. They will be comfortable working in cross functional teams based in EMEA and around the world including Finance &amp; Accounting, Business Operations, Data Science, Marketing, Product and Supply.</li> <li>The ideal candidate relishes the opportunity to roll up their sleeves to drive meaningful impact, possess strong stakeholder management skills, and is a self-starter that is comfortable with ambiguity in a fast paced global work environment.</li> <li>This person will have a high degree of visibility with senior management within the organization, including Country Managers, Regional and Finance Leaders.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>A Typical Day</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with a Country Manager in driving performance management, including development and ongoing analysis of KPIs, creating goals/OKRs and measuring performance.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of what levers drive growth and efficiency for our business and translating that into investment cases and initiatives to drive business impact.</li> <li>Partnering with the business on annual planning and budgeting, laying out risks and opportunities and debating strategies and capital allocation to maximise growth.</li> <li>Stepping in to lead EMEA’s monthly business review and speaking to key drivers of variance to goal and potential actions to improve performance.</li> <li>Modelling and summarising the implications of a regulatory action and potential mitigating actions we could take to minimize business impact.</li> <li>Joining a call with the Regional Marketing team to discuss changes to channel or country spend and helping bridge local and regional considerations.</li> <li>Digging into the regional impact of a global product feature and identifying relevant regional insights that could point to local optimization opportunities.</li> <li>Analytical deep dives: Conduct deep dives into business trends across EMEA and different segments of the business. Independently lead data extraction, analysis, visualization, and presentation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Build ad hoc reporting and analysis to help business operations and other cross functional partners understand the drivers of performance for key performance indicators.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>Your Expertise</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of relevant experience. Ideally, you have demonstrated relevant experience in an analytical role such as Strategic Finance, Financial Planning and Analytics (FP&amp;A), Strategy/Management Consulting, Investment Banking or Business Operations.&nbsp;</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, engineering, statistics or other relevant field that demonstrates quantitative orientation; MBA or advanced degree a plus.</li> <li>Superb financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills, SQL experience highly preferred.</li> <li>Strong analytical abilities and able to synthesize complex information. You enjoy absorbing large amounts of data and qualitative insights and can quickly develop a strong narrative that leads to recommendations and builds our understanding of the business.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: The ability to work and influence cross-functionally in a matrixed business environment is a must. You are proactive, great at communicating with different audiences and can bring stakeholders on-board. You seek out and have a track record for driving change and impact in a fluid, unstructured working environment.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to put together clear, polished, insightful recommendations for peers, managers and senior management.</li> <li>You’re very comfortable with financial modeling in Excel, and are willing to gather internal and external data points to help build a comprehensive business case.</li> <li>You’re someone who possesses grit and finds creative ways to get the job done. You bring high energy and the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast paced environment while balancing multiple projects.</li> <li>Relevant Sector Experience: Experience in B2C technology businesses is preferred, particularly Marketplace/Classifieds/E-Commerce businesses; broader experience in B2B technology, including Fintech and B2B Software will also be considered.</li> <li>Fluent in <strong>English and French</strong>.</li> <li>Experience in travel and hospitality is a plus.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">France Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€64.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€75.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.&nbsp; We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️ We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies. In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end : you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market. This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.

  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
  • Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
  • Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
  • Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare&nbsp;disease, and&nbsp;develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll&nbsp;ask&nbsp;"why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical &amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></p> <p>You will report to the Senior Director Commercial Excellence, International and work closely with country General Managers, International commercial functional leads, IT, and Medical Affairs to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic diseases and genetically driven cancers. This newly created role sits where International’s commercial strategy turns into field execution. Your primary purpose will be to build and own Sales Force Effectiveness, the International CRM platform, and key account management from the ground up, with a focus on launch readiness and flawless field execution across International markets. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in sales force effectiveness, CRM, and commercial operations with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.</p> <p><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead segmentation and targeting, sales force sizing and territory design as the International footprint grows, embedding data-driven insights into resource allocation, and build the Sales Force Effectiveness performance framework, including KPIs, dashboards, and regular reporting</li> <li>Design, implement, and administer sales incentive plans in close partnership with Finance, HR, Legal, and Compliance</li> <li>Lead the International CRM build and implementation, partnering with IT to deploy a lean, harmonized, fit-for-purpose Veeva Vault solution across markets, and own CRM operations, data stewardship, and adoption through training and change management</li> <li>Design AI-enabled field execution support, including next best action insights and recommendations</li> <li>Develop and implement the strategic account planning model and build key account management capability in the field, partnering with Medical Affairs and Market Access to expand access at account level</li> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to country General Managers and International functional leads on SFE, CRM, and account management, and support omnichannel customer engagement in partnership with the Customer Engagement Lead</li> <li>Support countries building up for launch with SFE, CRM, and field deployment readiness, ensure compliance with regional and local regulations, and build the International Sales Force Effectiveness function from the ground up</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Where You’ll Work&nbsp; </u></strong></p> <p>This is an office-based role in our Zug, Switzerland office, requiring in-office collaboration 2-3x per week, with additional travel of up to 20% across International markets to support country teams and launch readiness</p> <p><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>BA or BS in Business, Life Sciences, or a related field; MBA or other advanced degree/certification preferred</li> <li>10+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotech industry, including sales force effectiveness, sales operations, or commercial excellence, and experience directly supporting one or more product launches (specialty or rare disease strongly preferred)</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of designing and deploying sales force effectiveness frameworks across multiple markets, experience leading a CRM implementation or major platform roll-out, and experience designing and administering incentive compensation plans</li> <li>Strong analytical and data skills, including advanced Excel and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders, including country General Managers, without direct authority</li> <li>Prior exposure to multiple geographies strongly preferred, with deep expertise in at least one region required</li> <li>Fluency in English required; ability to travel up to 20%</li> </ul> <p><em>T</em><em>his position is available at Associate Director or Director level, will be determined by the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></strong></p> <p>We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</p> <ul> <li>Market leading compensation</li> <li>Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.&nbsp; <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare&nbsp;disease, and&nbsp;develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll&nbsp;ask&nbsp;"why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical &amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></p> <p>You will report to the Senior Director Commercial Excellence, International and work closely with country teams, International commercial functions, IT, and Corporate Communications to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic diseases and genetically driven cancers. Your primary purpose will be to build and own the International omnichannel customer engagement strategy, including digital and social activities across International markets. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in omnichannel and digital customer engagement with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.</p> <p><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the International omnichannel customer engagement strategy across HCPs and patients, designing customer journeys and defining channel mix, sequencing, and engagement across personal and digital touchpoints</li> <li>Partner with the Sales Force Effectiveness to embed omnichannel plans into CRM, field execution, and next best action, and advise country teams and customer-facing functions on effective use of engagement tools and content</li> <li>Own the International digital channel landscape, including disease-awareness websites, HCP portals, email and marketing automation, and paid and organic social media, setting the website strategy, content roadmap, and social media governance</li> <li>Set content operations standards, including modular content requirements and localization guardrails, and own the omnichannel requirements for the CRM and digital tech infrastructure in partnership with CommEx and IT</li> <li>Own the International omnichannel measurement plan, defining KPIs and generating actionable insights from campaign, channel, and CRM data, and champion innovative approaches to customer engagement, including AI and large language model applications, piloting new tools in a compliant and measurable way</li> <li>Direct and quality-check the delivery of pilot campaigns and ecosystem-build work against the channel plan and standards, and manage digital agencies and technology vendors supporting omnichannel delivery</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Where You’ll Work&nbsp; </u></strong></p> <p>This is an office-based role in our Zug, Switzerland office, requiring in-office collaboration 2-3x per week, with additional travel of up to 20% across International markets to support country teams, congresses, and launch readiness</p> <p><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>BA or BS in Business, Life Sciences, or a related field; MBA or other advanced degree/certification preferred</li> <li>8-10+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotech industry, including experience in omnichannel, digital, or customer engagement roles, supporting product launches (specialty or rare disease strongly preferred)</li> <li>Demonstrated experience designing and executing omnichannel customer engagement strategies across multiple markets</li> <li>Hands-on experience with digital channels and platforms, including websites, email and marketing automation, and social media, together with CRM</li> <li>Proven track record of change management and driving adoption of new channels, processes, and platforms</li> <li>Advanced analytical and strategic skills, with the ability to turn engagement and campaign data into clear decisions and recommendations; experience in a lean or growth-stage organization preferred</li> <li>Prior exposure to multiple geographies strongly preferred, with deep expertise in at least one region required; fluency in English required</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></strong></p> <p>We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</p> <ul> <li>Market leading compensation</li> <li>Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.&nbsp; <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts ( https://github.com/unit8co/darts ) Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers. Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor 15 paid days of holiday Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities. up to 10% of paid time for self-development. Flexible working hours, including some home office. Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites. If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position.
